sources.excerpt: Tone Chaser Published on January 28, 2023 C14 Devices distortion fuzz overdrive pedal Information C14 Devices The Tone Chaser is the first completely carbon fiber pedal in the world. Designed to find the perfect tone. You can generate sounds from harmonic and warm overdrive, to distortion and fuzz sounds with a lot of sustain. Distortion, fuzz and carbon fiber, the perfect combination.
